questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out

welcome_page.title: Safety when you are out
welcome_page.description:
How safe you feel from crime, harassment and traffic in the area where you move around most. It takes about 2 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

questionnaire.title: Safety when you are out

sections.title: Personal security
sections.description: Think about the area where you move around most, on foot or by other means.

questions.text: During the day, how safe do you feel from theft or assault in this area?
After dark, how safe do you feel from theft or assault in this area?
How often are you harassed when you are out (e.g. insults, comments, unwanted attention)?
What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3)

options.text: People behaving in a threatening way
Corners or places where you can't see well

sections.title: Road safety
sections.description: Think about traffic in the same area.

questions.text: How safe from traffic accidents do you feel in this area?
Which situations make you feel unsafe in traffic? (Up to 3)

options.text: Missing pavements, crossings or cycle lanes
Places where you can't see or be seen well
Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders or pedestrians
Too many people or vehicles in the same space

questions.text: In the last 2 years, has any of these happened to you? (Select all that apply)

options.text: I was hit by a vehicle while walking
I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. on a broken pavement)
I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter
I had a crash in a car or on a motorcycle

it.#SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out: SmartUrbanity - Sicurezza quando sei in giro
it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Alcune domande veloci per inquadrare le tue risposte.
it.#<p>Think about the area where you move: Pensa alla zona in cui ti muovi di più, a piedi o con altri mezzi.
it.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Di giorno, quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti o aggressioni in questa zona?
it.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Dopo il tramonto, quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti o aggressioni in questa zona?
it.#How often are you harassed when you are: Quanto spesso subisci molestie quando sei in giro (ad es. insulti, commenti, attenzioni indesiderate)?
it.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: Cosa ti fa sentire meno al sicuro? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Corners or places where you can't see w: Angoli o punti dove non si vede bene
it.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Quanto ti senti al sicuro dagli incidenti stradali in questa zona?
it.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Quali situazioni ti fanno sentire in pericolo nel traffico? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: Marciapiedi, attraversamenti o piste ciclabili mancanti
it.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: Punti dove non vedi o non sei visto/a bene
it.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Comportamenti imprudenti di automobilisti, motociclisti, ciclisti o pedoni
it.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Troppe persone o veicoli nello stesso spazio
it.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Negli ultimi 2 anni, ti è capitato qualcuno di questi episodi? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: Sono inciampato/a o caduto/a mentre camminavo (ad es. su un marciapiede rotto)
it.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: Ho avuto un incidente in bici o in monopattino
it.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: Ho avuto un incidente in auto o in moto
it.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
Quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti, molestie e traffico nella zona in cui ti muovi di più. Richiede circa 2 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out: SmartUrbanity - Sécurité lors de vos déplacements
fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Quelques questions rapides pour mettre vos réponses en contexte.
fr.#<p>Think about the area where you move: Pensez au quartier où vous vous déplacez le plus, à pied ou par d’autres moyens.
fr.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: En journée, dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri des vols ou des agressions dans ce quartier ?
fr.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Après la tombée de la nuit, dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri des vols ou des agressions dans ce quartier ?
fr.#How often are you harassed when you are: À quelle fréquence êtes-vous victime de harcèlement lors de vos déplacements (p. ex. insultes, remarques, attentions non désirées) ?
fr.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: Qu’est-ce qui vous fait sentir moins en sécurité ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#Nothing, I feel safe: Rien, je me sens en sécurité
fr.#Corners or places where you can't see w: Angles ou endroits où l’on voit mal
fr.#No cameras or staff: Absence de caméras ou de personnel
fr.#Things that happened there before: Des choses qui s’y sont déjà produites
fr.#<p>Think about traffic in the same area: Pensez à la circulation dans ce même quartier.
fr.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Dans quelle mesure vous sentez-vous à l’abri des accidents de la circulation dans ce quartier ?
fr.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Quelles situations vous font sentir en danger dans la circulation ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#None, I feel safe: Aucune, je me sens en sécurité
fr.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: Absence de trottoirs, de passages piétons ou de pistes cyclables
fr.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: Endroits où l’on voit mal ou où l’on est mal vu
fr.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Comportement imprudent des automobilistes, des personnes à vélo ou à moto, ou des piétons
fr.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Trop de personnes ou de véhicules dans le même espace
fr.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Au cours des 2 dernières années, l’une de ces situations vous est-elle arrivée ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#I was hit by a vehicle while walking: J’ai été heurté(e) par un véhicule en marchant
fr.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: J’ai trébuché ou je suis tombé(e) en marchant (p. ex. sur un trottoir abîmé)
fr.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: J’ai eu un accident à vélo ou en trottinette électrique
fr.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: J’ai eu un accident en voiture ou à moto
fr.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
Dans quelle mesure vous vous sentez à l’abri de la criminalité, du harcèlement et de la circulation dans le quartier où vous vous déplacez le plus. Cela prend environ 2 minutes.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas liées à votre nom. Elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Ein paar kurze Fragen, um Ihre Antworten einzuordnen.
de.#<p>Think about the area where you move: Denken Sie an das Gebiet, in dem Sie sich am meisten bewegen, zu Fuß oder mit anderen Verkehrsmitteln.
de.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich tagsüber in diesem Gebiet vor Diebstahl oder Übergriffen?
de.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit in diesem Gebiet vor Diebstahl oder Übergriffen?
de.#How often are you harassed when you are: Wie oft werden Sie unterwegs belästigt (z. B. Beleidigungen, Bemerkungen, unerwünschte Aufmerksamkeit)?
de.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: Was lässt Sie sich weniger sicher fühlen? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Corners or places where you can't see w: Ecken oder Stellen mit schlechter Sicht
de.#Things that happened there before: Vorfälle, die dort früher passiert sind
de.#<p>Think about traffic in the same area: Denken Sie an den Verkehr im selben Gebiet.
de.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich in diesem Gebiet vor Verkehrsunfällen?
de.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Welche Situationen lassen Sie sich im Verkehr unsicher fühlen? (Bis zu 3)
de.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: Stellen, an denen man schlecht sieht oder gesehen wird
de.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Rücksichtsloses Verhalten von Autofahrenden, Rad- oder Motorradfahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden
de.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Zu viele Personen oder Fahrzeuge auf engem Raum
de.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Ist Ihnen in den letzten 2 Jahren eines dieser Ereignisse passiert? (Alle zutreffenden auswählen)
de.#I was hit by a vehicle while walking: Ich wurde beim Gehen von einem Fahrzeug angefahren
de.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: Ich bin beim Gehen gestolpert oder gestürzt (z. B. auf einem beschädigten Gehweg)
de.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: Ich hatte einen Unfall mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter
de.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: Ich hatte einen Unfall mit dem Auto oder Motorrad
de.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
Wie sicher Sie sich vor Kriminalität, Belästigung und Verkehr in dem Gebiet fühlen, in dem Sie sich am meisten bewegen. Es dauert etwa 2 Minuten.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf verschiedene SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Yanıtlarınızı bağlamına oturtmak için birkaç kısa soru.
tr.#<p>Think about the area where you move: En çok hareket ettiğiniz bölgeyi düşünün; yürüyerek ya da başka araçlarla.
tr.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Gündüz, bu bölgede hırsızlık veya saldırıya karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Hava karardıktan sonra, bu bölgede hırsızlık veya saldırıya karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#How often are you harassed when you are: Dışarıdayken ne sıklıkla tacize uğruyorsunuz (örn. hakaret, laf atma, istenmeyen ilgi)?
tr.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: Kendinizi daha az güvende hissetmenize ne neden oluyor? (En fazla 3)
tr.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Bu bölgede trafik kazalarına karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Trafikte hangi durumlar kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: Kaldırım, geçit veya bisiklet şeridi eksikliği
tr.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Sürücülerin, motosiklet veya bisiklet kullananların ya da yayaların dikkatsiz davranışları
tr.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Aynı alanda çok fazla insan veya araç
tr.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Son 2 yılda bunlardan herhangi biri başınıza geldi mi? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: Yürürken tökezledim veya düştüm (örn. bozuk bir kaldırımda)
tr.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: Bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter ile kaza geçirdim
tr.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
En çok hareket ettiğiniz bölgede suça, tacize ve trafiğe karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissettiğiniz. Yaklaşık 2 dakika sürer.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. Yanıtlarınız, e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma bir kod altında saklanır; böylece farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtlar birlikte analiz edilebilir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi

fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: چند پرسش کوتاه برای قراردادن پاسخ‌های شما در بستر مناسب.
fa.#<p>Think about the area where you move: به منطقه‌ای فکر کنید که بیشتر در آن رفت‌وآمد می‌کنید، پیاده یا با وسایل دیگر.
fa.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: در طول روز، در این منطقه تا چه حد در برابر سرقت یا حمله احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: پس از تاریک شدن هوا، در این منطقه تا چه حد در برابر سرقت یا حمله احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#How often are you harassed when you are: وقتی بیرون هستید، چند وقت یک‌بار مورد آزار قرار می‌گیرید (مثلاً توهین، متلک، توجه ناخواسته)؟
fa.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: چه چیزی باعث می‌شود کمتر احساس امنیت کنید؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Corners or places where you can't see w: گوشه‌ها یا جاهایی که دید خوبی ندارید
fa.#Things that happened there before: اتفاق‌هایی که قبلاً آنجا رخ داده
fa.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: در این منطقه تا چه حد در برابر تصادفات رانندگی احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: چه وضعیت‌هایی در ترافیک باعث می‌شود احساس ناامنی کنید؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: نبود پیاده‌رو، گذرگاه یا مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: جاهایی که خوب نمی‌بینید یا دیده نمی‌شوید
fa.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: رفتار بی‌احتیاط رانندگان، موتورسواران یا دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران پیاده
fa.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: افراد یا خودروهای بیش‌ازحد در یک فضا
fa.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: در ۲ سال گذشته، آیا هر یک از این‌ها برای شما اتفاق افتاده است؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#I was hit by a vehicle while walking: هنگام پیاده‌روی یک خودرو با من برخورد کرد
fa.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: هنگام پیاده‌روی سکندری خوردم یا زمین خوردم (مثلاً روی پیاده‌روی خراب)
fa.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی تصادف کردم
fa.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: با خودرو یا موتورسیکلت تصادف کردم
fa.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
اینکه در منطقه‌ای که بیشتر در آن رفت‌وآمد می‌کنید، تا چه حد در برابر جرم، آزار و ترافیک احساس امنیت می‌کنید. حدود ۲ دقیقه زمان می‌برد.

شرکت در آن داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود. پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید

hu.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Válaszait elmentettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt ránk.
hu.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Néhány gyors kérdés, hogy válaszait összefüggéseiben lássuk.
hu.#<p>Think about the area where you move: Gondoljon arra a környékre, ahol a legtöbbet közlekedik, gyalog vagy más módon.
hu.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Napközben mennyire érzi magát biztonságban lopástól vagy támadástól ezen a környéken?
hu.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Sötétedés után mennyire érzi magát biztonságban lopástól vagy támadástól ezen a környéken?
hu.#How often are you harassed when you are: Milyen gyakran zaklatják, amikor úton van (pl. sértések, megjegyzések, nem kívánt figyelem)?
hu.#Corners or places where you can't see w: Sarkok vagy helyek, ahol nem lát jól
hu.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a közlekedési balesetektől ezen a környéken?
hu.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Milyen helyzetekben érzi magát veszélyben a forgalomban? (Legfeljebb 3)
hu.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: Helyek, ahol nem lát jól, vagy Önt nem látják jól
hu.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Autósok, motorosok, kerékpárosok vagy gyalogosok felelőtlen viselkedése
hu.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Túl sok ember vagy jármű ugyanabban a térben
hu.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Az elmúlt 2 évben történt Önnel ezek közül valamelyik? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: Gyaloglás közben megbotlottam vagy elestem (pl. töredezett járdán)
hu.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: Balesetet szenvedtem kerékpárral vagy elektromos rollerrel
hu.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
Mennyire érzi magát biztonságban a bűnözéstől, a zaklatástól és a forgalomtól azon a környéken, ahol a legtöbbet közlekedik. Kitöltése körülbelül 2 percet vesz igénybe.

A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszait nem kapcsoljuk össze a nevével. A válaszokat az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kód alatt tároljuk, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

Tudjon meg többet a SmartUrbanity projektről

ar.#SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out: SmartUrbanity - السلامة عندما تكون في الخارج
ar.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: تم حفظ إجاباتك. شكرًا لك على وقتك.
ar.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: بضعة أسئلة سريعة لوضع إجاباتك في سياقها.
ar.#<p>Think about the area where you move: فكّر في المنطقة التي تتنقل فيها أكثر من غيرها، سيرًا على الأقدام أو بوسائل أخرى.
ar.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: خلال النهار، إلى أي حد تشعر بالأمان من السرقة أو الاعتداء في هذه المنطقة؟
ar.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: بعد حلول الظلام، إلى أي حد تشعر بالأمان من السرقة أو الاعتداء في هذه المنطقة؟
ar.#How often are you harassed when you are: كم مرة تتعرض للمضايقة عندما تكون في الخارج (مثل الشتائم أو التعليقات أو الاهتمام غير المرغوب فيه)؟
ar.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: ما الذي يجعلك تشعر بأمان أقل؟ (3 على الأكثر)
ar.#Corners or places where you can't see w: زوايا أو أماكن لا ترى فيها جيدًا
ar.#Neglected places (abandoned buildings,: أماكن مهملة (مبانٍ مهجورة، كتابات على الجدران)
ar.#<p>Think about traffic in the same area: فكّر في حركة المرور في المنطقة نفسها.
ar.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: إلى أي حد تشعر بالأمان من حوادث المرور في هذه المنطقة؟
ar.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: ما الحالات التي تجعلك تشعر بعدم الأمان في حركة المرور؟ (3 على الأكثر)
ar.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: غياب الأرصفة أو المعابر أو مسارات الدراجات
ar.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: أماكن لا ترى فيها جيدًا أو لا يراك فيها الآخرون جيدًا
ar.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: سلوك متهور من السائقين أو راكبي الدراجات النارية والهوائية أو المشاة
ar.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: عدد كبير جدًا من الأشخاص أو المركبات في المساحة نفسها
ar.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: خلال العامين الماضيين، هل حدث لك أي من هذه الأمور؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: تعثرت أو سقطت أثناء المشي (مثلًا على رصيف متكسر)
ar.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: تعرضت لحادث وأنا على دراجة أو سكوتر كهربائي
ar.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: تعرضت لحادث وأنا في سيارة أو على دراجة نارية
ar.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
إلى أي حد تشعر بالأمان من الجريمة والمضايقة وحركة المرور في المنطقة التي تتنقل فيها أكثر من غيرها. يستغرق نحو دقيقتين.
